facts.statement: The study introduces multiVIB, a computational method that uses probabilistic contrastive learning to align different types of single-cell data.
facts.subject: computational

facts.statement: Testing on various benchmarks showed that the method performs well at integrating data while avoiding false matches between unrelated samples.
facts.subject: computational

facts.statement: The framework was applied to nine different molecular data types collected from the mouse primary motor cortex to build a comprehensive atlas.
facts.subject: computational

facts.statement: The method also successfully integrated gene expression data from primate basal ganglia to identify cell types shared across species and those unique to each.
facts.subject: computational

facts.statement: The authors conclude that this approach provides a reliable way to build and expand large-scale maps of brain cell types.
facts.subject: computational
